task: An explanation of the elevator riddle.

criteria.text: The man cannot reach the elevator buttons above the 7th floor (he is too short, or equivalently cannot reach the higher buttons).
On rainy days he has an umbrella (or similar object he carries only then) and uses it to press the 10th-floor button.
Does not blame the elevator, which the riddle says works perfectly.

reference: He is too short to reach buttons above 7; on rainy days he carries an umbrella and uses it to press 10.
notes: Health or exercise explanations do not explain the rain exception and fail c1/c2.
